metadata.rationale: Single 416.4s source analysed as podcast b-roll, medium motion, conf 0.50. With no beat grid, no motionPeak timestamps and no transcript in the analysis, the edit is authored structurally instead of reactively: a 3-frame cold-open teaser, a held title card, then a jump-cut argument spine that accelerates across three phases (avg shot 2.06s -> 1.44s -> 0.98s) and lands on a 4.2s pull-back hold. Because analysis confidence is only 0.50 and the material is a podcast (faces likely present), treatment stays conservative: one coherent colour grade, short tonal/vignette/grain/glow hits, zero glitch, zero chromatic aberration, zero blur on picture. Each shot keeps its own sync audio (authentic podcast jump-cut behaviour); a low 0.16 bed from the show's own audio keeps the timeline from ever going silent. Total 45.0s exactly.
